# EcoFinds - Sustainable Second-Hand Marketplace

## Project Overview
EcoFinds is a full-stack marketplace application for buying and selling second-hand items, built with React.js frontend and Node.js/Express backend with MongoDB database.

## Running the Project

### Backend (Port 5000)
```bash
cd ecofinde-backend
npm install
npm run dev
```

### Frontend (Port 3000)
```bash
cd ecofinde-frontend
npm install
npm start
```

## Key Features Implemented
- User authentication (register/login)
- Product listing management (CRUD operations)
- Product browsing with search and filtering
- Shopping cart functionality
- User profile dashboard
- Order history tracking
- Responsive design with styled-components

## Technologies Used
- Frontend: React.js, React Router, Styled Components, Axios
- Backend: Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Mongoose, JWT, bcrypt
- Database: MongoDB with text indexing for search
